{{Quote|Tell your master I find his hospitality most generous, but an allergy to most insects means I'll have to decline snacking on those crunchbugs.|Corran Horn refuses crunchbugs offered to him by Shala the Hutt|<ref name="I,J" />}}
'''Crunchbugs''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Insect/Legends|insects]] that were enjoyed as a snack [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] by members of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] species. They produced chirping or peeping sounds. In [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], the Hutt [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Shala]] offered the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] a bowl of live crunchbugs in his [[Shala's base|base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Courkrus]], but the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] had to decline as he claimed to have an [[Allergy/Legends|allergy]] to insects. Horn later reflected that he wished to he could use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to perform a census of all the crunchbugs living in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Vlarnya]] on the planet.<ref name="I,J" /> In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], crunchbugs were served at a huge feast held by [[Popara Anjiliac Diresto]] in his [[Popara's penthouse|penthouse]] on the planet [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]].<ref name="Sc">[[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Crunchbugs were first mentioned in the [[1998]] novel ''[[I, Jedi]]'' written by [[Michael A. Stackpole]] and then again in the [[2012]] novel [[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']] written by [[Jeff Grubb]]. Scourge is a novelized version of the [[Wizards of the Coast]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' adventure ''[[Tempest Feud]]'', although the insects are not mentioned in the original RPG material.
